eligibility: 1. Citizens of countries other than the PRC who are committed to the nuclear industry
existing.eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries other than PRC committed to the nuclear industry for societal benefit, in good health. Holders of Bachelor's or Master's degree in relevant majors (nuclear engineering, nuclear technology, mechanics, energy, chemical engineering, physics) with strong scientific research capability. Proficiency in English. Master's applicants under 35 years old; PhD applicants under 40 years old. Preference given to those with work experience in nuclear or related fields.
